response.sql: WITH analysed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS trade_record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM analysed_trades GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
